title: Neuromorphic Software Guide
summary: This page serves as a curated directory of open-source tools for neuromorphic computing and spiking neural networks (SNNs). It lists software libraries supporting gradient-based training, simulation on GPUs/TPUs/CPU, event camera data processing, and hardware-in-the-loop development. Resources cover various frameworks including PyTorch extensions, JAX implementations, C++ simulators, and domain-specific languages for neuron modeling. The collection emphasizes interoperability across different neuromorphic processors and computational backends.
tldr: A curated directory of open-source software tools supporting spiking neural network simulation, training, event camera processing, and hardware-in-the-loop development.
evidence: Explore our curated collection of open source neuromorphic software resources.
- Focuses on gradient-based training of SNNs, based on PyTorch for GPU acceleration and gradient computation.
- Free, open-source simulator for SNNs, written in Python, focusing on ease of use and flexibility.
